description: Shows what an incoming 1V per octave signal comes to, as a note name with its cents deviation, as a voltage, or as a frequency

inputs.text: Reads the voltage at this jack out on the line beside it; a polyphonic cable fills one line per channel, taking over the lines belonging to the jacks below it

notes: every jack is polyphonic, and a cable with several channels pushes the readings for the jacks under it off the bottom of the panel
the readings are refreshed every hundredth sample rather than every sample
in note-name mode a voltage that does not land exactly on a note is shown with its distance from the nearest one in cents
menu: Sharps or Flats: Sharp, Flat — chooses how an accidental is spelled
Display type: Note Name, Voltage (V), V/Oct as Frequency (Hz) — chooses what the lines show
Number decimal places in voltage/frequency display: 0 to 8 — sets how many figures follow the point in the voltage and frequency readings
